title: ModernisationStrategy
description: The modernisation areas of the project, one per candidate place, with the patterns that fit each of them, the counted evidence for and against them and the figures the cost of the change rests on

reasoning.description: Overall reasoning: how the areas were derived from the anchors, the hotspots and the counted evidence, and that the order follows the counted cost and the choice of the area to work on is the reader's

areas.description: One entry per modernisation area, ordered by the cost the counted evidence implies

module.description: The module the area belongs to, empty when the area belongs to the project rather than to one module

element.description: The class, interface or thing the area points at, empty when the area has none, for example an area of a build unit

anchorType.description: The kind of anchor the area rests on

patterns.description: The patterns of the catalogue that fit the area, empty when no pattern of the catalogue fits it

name.description: The name of the pattern of the catalogue

evidenceFor.description: The counted evidence that supports the pattern for this area, every entry naming the analysis that counted it

evidenceAgainst.description: The counted evidence that counts against the pattern for this area, empty when no evidence against the pattern was found

whatWouldMakeItWrong.description: What would have to be true for the pattern to be the wrong choice for this area

costFigures.description: The figures the cost of the area rests on, among them the afferent coupling of the module, the strength of the reference a cut would sever and the test coverage of the area

name.description: The name of the figure, for example the afferent coupling of the module or the test coverage of the area

value.description: The value of the figure, as the counted analysis reports it

source.description: The counted analysis the figure comes from

cost.description: A short statement of what the change of this area would cost, resting on the figures that are named beside it

reasoning.description: Why this area was read as it was, and why the patterns that fit it fit it

absentTypes.description: One entry per area type whose input analysis did not run, with the type and the reason

type.description: The absent area type: one of anchor, hotspot, or the name of an anchor type whose analysis did not run while the anchor analysis did

reason.description: Why the area type is absent, for example that the hotspot analysis did not run
